summary: Kootenai NF crow's nest with tent cabin, listed under 1935 and abandoned in 1941; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Crow's nest with a tent cabin
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned in 1941; no source says what remains.

events.note: Listed under 1935 as a crow's nest with a tent cabin. The entry does not give a build date or builder.

evidence.supports: The lookout is in the Kootenai National Forest.
The lookout is about 25 miles east of Libby.
The lookout is in Lincoln County, Montana.
The elevation is listed as 5,553 feet.
The page lists a crow's nest with a tent cabin under 1935.
The page is headed as a fire lookout tower.
The association's Montana list shows Wolf Peak as a crow's nest with the status abandoned.

notes_for_editor: Two short pages only. The firelookout.com entry puts a crow's nest with tent cabin under 1935 and abandonment in 1941 in one line, with no build date or builder, so 1935 is the earliest listed date, not a confirmed build year. The page heading says Tower while both the entry and the association list say crow's nest; the story says so. No staffing, fire or current-site source found after two WebSearch queries and one listing. The brief's kind 'platform' matches the vocab (crow's nests), so it is kept. Agency was null and is filled from the Kootenai National Forest line. The source gives elevation 5,553 ft (about 1,693 m), but facts has no elevation key, so it is not recorded here; add it to elevation_m if the record allows. Do not confuse with Wolf Mountain (Lincoln County, camp abandoned) on the same list, a different site. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the 1935 event changed from built to other, since the entry gives no build date; facts.status changed from gone to unknown, since abandoned does not mean gone and no source says what remains.
